items.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I mean I wish I’d been able to see people like Bird, Bud Powell, I mean Coltrane.

ctx.x: That’s a big list. I mean I wish I’d been able to see people like Bird, Bud Powell, I mean Coltrane. Because the energy and the feeling you get from the recorded medium is phenomenal but that never approaches what it’s like to be in the room. I mean when you’re in the room with the sound it changes your life forever. I mean the first time I heard Miles Davis is was like, or the first time you, like I remember the first time I sat next to Philly Joe Jones and it was like oh man. Those things, you never forget…

What you just said about being in the room, that’s the thing right there. Not a record, not a CD, but being in the room. Like I would love to have been sitting somewhere in a room where Tatum was playing.
